description: Arena List Games. WHEN: pick a game id before arena_join. Default is a compact list (id, name, short) plus a hint. Pass detail:true for short_rules, legal_moves, duration_hint. limit:0 or all:true returns the full rich catalog (heavy). No auth. Example: arena_list_games {}

all.description: true returns the full rich catalog in one reply (heavy, same as limit:0).

detail.description: true returns short_rules, legal_moves, duration_hint (same paging as default).

limit.description: Page size (default 12, max 50; 0 = full rich catalog, heavy).

offset.description: Start index for the next page (see next_offset).

q.description: Optional substring filter on id or title.

name: arena_list_games
title: Arena List Games
